requirements.heading: Mail Senders
requirements.text: The List-Unsubscribe header field MUST contain one HTTPS URI.

requirements.heading: Mail Senders
requirements.text: It MAY contain other non-HTTP/S URIs such as MAILTO:.

requirements.heading: Mail Senders
requirements.text: The List-Unsubscribe-Post header MUST contain the single key/value pair "List-Unsubscribe=One-Click".

requirements.heading: Mail Senders
requirements.text: As described below, the message MUST have a valid DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) signature that covers at least the List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post headers.

requirements.heading: Mail Senders
requirements.text: The URI in the List-Unsubscribe header MUST contain enough information to identify the mail recipient and the list from which the recipient is to be removed, so that the unsubscription process can complete automatically.

requirements.heading: Mail Senders
requirements.text: The POST request MUST NOT include cookies, HTTP authorization, or any other context information.

requirements.heading: Mail Senders
requirements.text: The URI SHOULD include an opaque identifier or another hard-to-forge component in addition to, or instead of, the plaintext names of the list and the subscriber.

requirements.heading: Mail Senders
requirements.text: The server handling the unsubscription SHOULD verify that the opaque or hard-to-forge component is valid.

requirements.heading: Mail Senders
requirements.text: The mail sender MUST NOT return an HTTPS redirect, since redirected POST actions have historically not worked reliably, and many browsers have turned redirected HTTP POSTs into GETs.

requirements.heading: Mail Receivers
requirements.text: The POST content SHOULD be sent as 'multipart/form-data' [RFC7578] or MAY be sent as 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'.

requirements.heading: Mail Receivers
requirements.text: The mail receiver MUST NOT perform a POST on the HTTPS URI without user consent.

requirements.heading: Additional Requirements
requirements.text: Hence, senders MUST apply at least one valid DKIM signature to the message.

requirements.heading: Additional Requirements
requirements.text: The List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post headers MUST be covered by the signature and included in the "h=" tag of a valid DKIM-Signature header field.

requirements.heading: Additional Requirements
requirements.text: If the message does not have the required DKIM signature, the mail receiver SHOULD NOT offer a one-click unsubscribe for that message.

requirements.heading: Security Considerations
requirements.text: Since the mailer's server that receives the POST request cannot in general tell where the request is coming from, the URI SHOULD contain an opaque identifier or another hard-to-forge component to identify the list and recipient address.

requirements.heading: Security Considerations
requirements.text: Also, the request MUST NOT include cookies or other context information to prevent the server from associating the request with previous web requests.
